agent_priors_used: PRIOR (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): a research program that repeatedly cannot distinguish 'no effect' from 'no power' has an identifiability defect, and the correct remedy is a planted-signal positive control with a matched null, not another null. Used to justify Physics buying power calibration instead of another real-trajectory CMI run.

PRIOR (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): for a memory-or-compilation product, the decisive economic number is the break-even reuse count at which the amortized build and verification cost is repaid, not the average per-hit saving. Break-even is typically far above what benchmarks assume and is cheap to compute before any expensive end-to-end run. Used to justify Product computing f* rather than re-running the full Pareto packet.

PRIOR (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): a deterministic scripted or compiled executor is a strong and cheap baseline that most 'learning system' evaluations omit. If such an executor is absent from the comparison, an inheritance claim can be true for the wrong reason. Used to justify Frontier's no-memory deterministic executor as the primary control against SPIDER's own premise.

PRIOR (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): parallel agent lanes drift in their environment assumptions and produce contradictory capability probes; a single shared, fail-closed, machine-readable environment contract plus an artifact-durability rule is usually worth more than one additional experiment, because it converts blocked cycles into runnable or explicitly parked ones. Used to justify Runtime's capability ledger and substrate contract as the portfolio's primary deliverable.

PRIOR (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): browser automation stacks expose internal, version-pinned helper APIs; tests that gate an entire experiment on such a private helper will keep failing across versions. Public entry points and on-disk browser paths are the durable formulation. Used to justify demoting Runtime's frozen private-helper gate to a non-vetoing public-API probe.

PRIOR (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): long-horizon web agents fail through path dependence, salience from prior context, and compounding error; correspondingly, unbounded recall without calibrated abstention can be net-negative, and verification cost grows faster than exploration saved as inherited knowledge ages. Used only to motivate the architecture shape and to justify making a no-memory control and a false-accept gate mandatory in Frontier's and Graph's mandates.

PRIOR (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): research programs that repeatedly restate the same question with more thresholds accumulate false precision rather than knowledge, and the marginal value of the k-th such experiment falls faster than its cost. Used to terminate, by mandate, the DM/CMI/Gamma-ratio permutation family and the synthetic-alias economics family rather than merely parking them.

PRIOR (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): preconditions that can never be satisfied should be detected and repaired before, not during, the experiment that depends on them. Used to make the kernel-durability contradiction a first-class deliverable for Runtime rather than a silent gate failure inside Graph's and Product's packets.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Against the inherited handoff, which proposes the same public-API browser preflight as a mandatory gate: the preflight is a good experiment and I am keeping it, but as the mandatory gate it reproduces the exact failure that voided the last five packets, because a preflight that gates the whole experiment converts every future environment drift into a null cycle. Demoting it to a non-vetoing standalone capability result is strictly better: it still produces the launchability fact, and its failure no longer destroys a valid measurement of the control matrix, which is the actual next_gate in the claim registry. Against repeating the full C1-C8 browser composite: the browser-dependent half has produced no observation five times running, so repeating it buys no information; the control-matrix half has never been run to completion and is exactly the registry next gate. Against PIVOT to a permanent browser specialty: the Codex shows the browser is the disputed capability, not the stable one, and Runtime must not acquire a micro-specialty in the thing that keeps failing. Opportunity cost accepted: a strictly smaller scientific result from Runtime this cycle, in exchange for the ledger and contract that determine whether three other lanes can run at all.
allocation.question: Can C-MEAS-VALID be advanced on a substrate whose validity is no longer voided by provisioning failure, in three parts with an explicit precedence rule that makes infrastructure failure non-vetoing? Part A, PRIMARY: on the already-certified distributed stable-header shared-WAL plain-HTTP substrate, does the full intervention-validity control matrix produce discriminating outcomes, namely that each positive intervention (valid-auth write, induced drift) is detected and each matched null (read-only, invalid-auth, expired-auth, deleted-session) leaves the shared WAL byte-identical, with reported sensitivity and specificity and confidence intervals that are non-degenerate, and with browser capability treated as an independent sub-result rather than a precondition of the matrix? Part B: can a real Chromium be launched at 1280x720 through the PUBLIC Playwright API, using p.chromium.executable_path or an equivalent independently verified public entry point, producing a real CDP DOM plus Accessibility.getFullAXTree capture and one reversible valid-auth SPA write with before and after WAL evidence, read-only, invalid-auth, expired-auth and deleted-session controls leaving the WAL unchanged, with no synthetic fallback; reported as a standalone capability result whose failure is recorded as UNAVAILABLE with the exact artifact and the single smallest unblocking action, and forbidden from vetoing Part A? Part C: can a single machine-readable, fail-closed capability ledger and a one-command substrate bring-up contract be published, covering python dependency presence, browser launchability, browsergym and agentlab importability, policy-model credential presence, HF and GHCR reachability, plus the exact distributed-substrate commands, ports, WAL path and schema, health checks, and the certified n_non304 and X-Worker-Pid floors, so that Graph, Product, Physics and Frontier can each pre-register it as a precondition and fail closed on it, thereby resolving the mutually contradictory capability probes currently in the Codex? Additionally, is the frozen durability precondition, under which a kernel or harness capability must exist at HEAD rather than only in the working tree, satisfiable at all given that lane workflows forbid commits, and if not, what is the smallest sanctioned durability path that preserves reproducibility without permitting an in-place uncommitted capability to be measured?
allocation.rationale: Runtime's charter is to prioritize substrate work that unblocks important live questions, and no other question is blocking more lanes. The recorded evidence shows the block is not the science of the substrate but the failure of experiments to be robust to the environment. Runtime's last packet voided all five raw observation streams because a frozen gate required the private helper playwright._impl._path_utils.get_executable_path, absent in installed Playwright 1.63.0, even though the official Chromium binary path was recorded as present. Frontier's most recent accepted run reported all eight primary controls and all six null controls as NOT_RUN with browsergym_available=false, and one accepted Intel audit from the same window reported those very packages installed with twelve successful 1280x720 CDP captures at median 707 accessibility nodes. That contradiction is the most urgent unknown in the program and Runtime is the only lane whose charter covers it. Part C additionally fixes a failure mode already seen three times in the Codex, where a downstream lane failed because the substrate was never started, which means the substrate existed and was certified but was not reachable by contract.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER has 384 canonical experiments, 10 claims, and ZERO claims at VALIDATED or PRODUCT_CORE. The only audited VALIDATED scope anywhere in the program is C-MEAS-VALID on a bounded plain-HTTP localhost substrate (EXP-RUNTIME-36094450333, EXP-RUNTIME-36100549580). Everything else is HYPOTHESIS, MEASUREMENT_INVALID, or a bounded synthetic SURVIVES/FALSIFIED ceiling. The decisive change in the recent window is not scientific: the dominant failure mode has shifted from wrong answers to no answer. Recurring causes recorded in the Codex are (1) an unlaunchable browser/CDP path (Runtime's frozen gate required the private helper playwright._impl._path_utils.get_executable_path, absent in installed 1.63.0, which voided all five raw observation streams; Frontier's substrate diagnostic reported browsergym-core/playwright/agentlab not installed), (2) substrates never started at all (C-DELTA-REPAIR provenance: substrate_started=false, health_gate_pass=false, n_non304=0; C-PARAM-INHERIT: the B run made zero HTTP requests), (3) non-durable implementation (the C-PARAM-INHERIT audit found the harness substitute standing in for the kernel's distill_parameterized, and C-PRODUCT-ECON/C-LLM-INHERIT both recorded a working-tree kernel sha that differs from HEAD with commit_made=false because the lane workflow forbids commits), and (4) absent credentials (OPENAI_API_KEY absent, HF_TOKEN absent, GHCR browsergym 403). Consequently the program currently cannot distinguish 'no effect' from 'no measurement' on any central claim. Two structural facts govern this cycle. First, the Codex now contains mutually contradictory capability probes for the same environment: one accepted Intel audit recorded pip-installed BrowserGym-core 0.14.3, AgentLab 0.4.2 and Playwright 1.63.0 with 12 successful 1280x720 CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree captures at median 707 nodes, while an accepted Frontier substrate diagnostic reported those same packages not installed, and the director environment itself exposes none of them. The capability surface is not merely missing, it is unidentifiable. Second, without a policy-model credential the token dimension of cost is degenerate, so every token-denominated economic claim (C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-LLM-INHERIT) is NOT_APPLICABLE this cycle no matter which lane spends it; the measurable dimensions are observation, request, verification, repair and latency work. The reachable real-evidence substrate is narrow but genuinely real: a local distributed HTTP service with real auth, session, ETag/304, sticky routing and worker spread, plus a real browser IF AND ONLY IF a capability ledger certifies it. I therefore direct all six lanes onto that reachable real substrate, and I make two structural changes that matter more than any individual experiment: (a) infrastructure failure must no longer be able to void a measurement of a quantity that is reachable, and (b) a single machine-readable capability ledger plus a one-command substrate bring-up contract must be published so that lanes pre-register it and fail closed on it instead of discovering absence at minute 90. Declined this cycle, explicitly, as poor use of intelligence: another correlation sweep of residual-novelty on synthetic alias fixtures (32 experiments on the claim, 16 recent, already validly falsified non-Pareto at EXP-FRONTIER-36042599040 with audit PASS), another Dirichlet-Multinomial/CMI/Gamma-ratio permutation on a synthetic DGP (79 experiments on C-WEB-DYNAMICS, 8 recent, zero valid inference to real Web), and a tenth WebGym census attempt against an absent credential (9 consecutive failures with the same documented smallest-next-action). The frontier thread has also never asked the question that could invalidate the product: whether a no-memory deterministic executor matches inherited execution at all. I assign that this cycle because it is reachable, decisive, and it is a null against SPIDER's own premise.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The brief was used as staff advice and materially changed four of six lanes, but I rejected or rewrote its central prescription. ACCEPTED: the brief's diagnosis that the program is in a multi-lane infrastructure tunnel and that Runtime's browser provisioning is the highest-leverage blocker. Adopted, with one amendment I consider necessary: the browser probe must be NON-VETOING, because the single most wasteful pattern in the Codex is a provisioning failure voiding an otherwise-valid measurement of a reachable quantity, which is exactly what happened across the last five C-MEAS-VALID packets. REJECTED: the brief's proposal that Physics pivot to real BrowserGym trajectory analysis with corrected per-stratum Gamma-ratio estimators. That is a fifteenth execution of an inferential family that has produced zero valid real-Web inference in 79 experiments, on data that is not reachable. I substituted a planted-signal power calibration, which is the only measurement that can learn whether the family is capable of detecting anything at achievable N; real-trajectory analysis is deferred behind the capability ledger rather than attempted blind. REJECTED AS STATED: the brief's cross-lane 'real BrowserGym data first' policy. As a directive it is unreachable and would have produced a sixty-first MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Replaced with a reachable-real-substrate policy: the certified distributed real HTTP service for all lanes, plus a real browser only if and only if a capability ledger certifies it, with unreachable quantities reported explicitly UNKNOWN instead of surrogate-filled. REWRITTEN: the brief's Frontier proposal to test AgentJIT/COVENANT-style deterministic compilation bypass on real heterogeneous BrowserGym tasks. Compilation is a strong ally in the brief's framing; I inverted it and used a no-memory deterministic executor as the strongest null against SPIDER's own premise, which is reachable without a public-Web corpus and without a policy model. The brief did not propose this test and it is the most decision-altering falsification available in the program. REJECTED: the brief's recommendation to PARK Product. Parking a lane that owns the shipped surface and the honest accounting would leave the product thesis unowned for a cycle when a decision-grade deliverable, the break-even reuse count, is computable today without credentials. Product is redirected to freeze the evaluation instrument and compute f*, and to stop freezing further C-PRODUCT-ECON Pareto packets until a policy model and a certified browser exist. AMENDED AND SHARPENED: the brief's recommendation that Intel accept the pinned-source fallback and stop burning cycles on HF_TOKEN. I agree and go further: Intel's next job is the credential-free corpus-and-capability inventory, because the Codex contains contradictory probes about the same environment and four lanes are blocked on that contradiction rather than on science. That is a strictly better use of Intel than a tenth census attempt. ANSWERED, NOT ADOPTED: the brief's question about reopening C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE and C-LLM-INHERIT (zero recent Graph experiments). I defer both. Abstention and applicability calibration is only interpretable if the staleness signal's false-accept rate is measured first, and LLM inheritance is degenerate without a policy-model credential. Reopening either now would produce an uninterpretable metric. The brief's external findings, including AgentJIT at 10.4x, COVENANT at 50 to 83 percent, TraceCompiler and HMT, are correctly labelled in the brief as non-evidence; I have not treated any of them as SPIDER evidence, and I routed only the decision-relevant and cheaply obtainable part, a primary-source specification of what those systems actually compile and how they account for cost, to Intel as an explicitly non-reproduction task.
